source_snapshot.procedure: Install OS; physically unplug the machine for 30 seconds; power on; log into iLO and enter Advanced License if needed; wait at least five minutes; record Maximum Available/Peak Observed/Minimum Observed; disable capping and stress 15 minutes; record metrics and Present Power; enable capping at Present Power; refresh the 20-Minute History Graph; record Average/Maximum and excursions; reduce the cap approximately 5 W per iteration until the MSAC value.
source_snapshot.criteria: System caps power; Average Power stays below Power Cap while Maximum Power may cross above it.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes one user-selected cap plus read-only telemetry, omitting OS/AC preparation, secure license, baseline stress, graph windows, iterative 5 W sweep, MSAC, watchdogs and restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED until MSAC, safe decrement/stop semantics, platform/license applicability and recovery were authoritatively defined.

old_problem: Step 16 references an undefined MSAC value allegedly obtained earlier, leaving a repeated performance-limiting sweep without a safe floor. HPE's official iLO Redfish documentation now defines MinimumSafelyAchievableCap and a validity flag, supplies the previously missing authoritative terminal semantic, and documents power-cap limit/average/maximum fields. Remaining platform version, thresholds, workload, physical feed and restoration inputs are bounded Project requirements.
disposition_reason: Apply only to an approved HPE iLO platform that exposes a valid OEM MinimumSafelyAchievableCap. Preserve the physical 30-second AC preparation, actual iLO/license/WebUI evidence, uncapped 15-minute stress baseline, Present Power initial cap, complete 20-minute graph evaluation at each scheduled approximately-5-W decrement, and the final valid MSAC step. A human handles OS/license/AC/UI phases; monitoring and workload may be automated after approval. Never go below MSAC, skip a graph window, retry a failed step or leave the cap changed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 991, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 992 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 992 / variant 87d08d0aa322ef67.

HPE iLO documentation defines OEM `MinimumSafelyAchievableCap` as the lowest safe group-manager cap for a server and requires `MinimumSafelyAchievableCapValid` to be true. This resolves the acronym, value source and safe lower bound without inventing a wattage.

HPE also defines LimitInWatts, AverageConsumedWatts over IntervalInMin, MaxConsumedWatts and warnings for low/unreachable cap values. Exact firmware/resource applicability and Project watchdog limits remain mandatory.

The 60-minute Machine Time is planning metadata under ED-07/08; it cannot compress the explicit 15-minute baseline plus a full 20-minute history evaluation at every cap step. Scheduled decrements are planned iterations, not retries; a failed step stops the sweep.

ED-05 through ED-08, ED-11 through ED-19, ED-21 and ED-24 through ED-31 preserve Master phases, manual AC/WebUI evidence, storage safety, complete duration/iterations, stop/recovery and independent verdict; ED-33 through ED-38 allow parameterized execution with protected tools.

test_case.test_name: Sweep HPE iLO power cap from Present Power to valid MSAC in approximately 5 W steps
test_case.purpose: On a qualified HPE iLO platform, verify power-capping behavior under approved stress from Present Power through scheduled approximately-5-W decrements down to the firmware-reported valid Minimum Safely Achievable Cap, with actual 20-minute Power Meter evidence, safety monitoring and full state restoration.
required_package: Immutable HPE server/iLO/firmware/WebUI identity and discovered OEM resource exposing non-null MinimumSafelyAchievableCap with MinimumSafelyAchievableCapValid=true, plus qualified cap resource/domain/units
Approved OS image and exact nonproduction installation target with storage allowlist, backup/recovery and post-install validation
Complete PSU/feed/outlet/cable map, human AC operator, 30-second dwell timer, isolated maintenance window and proof all required feeds are removed/restored without shared-equipment impact
Secure authorized iLO Advanced License workflow and actual rendered UI routes for Measured Power Values, cap settings and 20-Minute History Graph; secrets excluded from evidence
Approved stress tool/version/profile, uncapped 15-minute baseline and per-step full 20-minute observation plan with synchronized Average/Maximum/Cap, OS performance and HPE/iLO telemetry

Captured original cap state, valid MSAC, Present Power, approximately-5-W schedule ending exactly at MSAC, sampling/tolerance, thermal/power/performance/OS/BMC thresholds, abort/recovery and final-state restoration
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. After separate authorization, a qualified engineer installs the approved OS only on the allowlisted target, verifies it, then with the SUT shut down removes every mapped AC feed for 30 seconds and restores it; power on and prove POST/OS Ready. Verify exact HPE iLO/firmware and securely establish the approved Advanced License without recording the key. Preserve logs and original cap state. After at least five minutes and valid graphs, capture rendered Maximum Available, Peak Observed and Minimum Observed. Disable capping, read back, run the pinned stress continuously for 15 minutes and capture the repeated values plus Present Power. Discover/read valid MSAC. Enable capping at Present Power, read back, and for each scheduled value `next=max(valid_MSAC, prior-approximately-5W)` apply once through the qualified human UI/control, record actual delta/readback, run the unchanged stress and collect a complete 20-minute graph window plus synchronized watchdog evidence. Require Average below Cap by the approved tolerance; record allowed Maximum crossings and performance impact. Stop after evaluating MSAC exactly. On any failure, stop without retry. Restore original cap enable/value/mode and final workload/health, verify readback and preserve all logs.
test_case.expected_result: The qualified iLO reports a valid MSAC; the uncapped baseline and Present Power are captured; every scheduled cap from Present Power down to and including MSAC is accepted/read back once and receives its complete 20-minute observation. At every passing step Average Power is below the Cap under the approved window/tolerance, Maximum crossings are recorded as allowed, and thermal/power/performance/OS/BMC health remain inside approved limits. No step goes below MSAC and the original cap/system state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact HPE/iLO applicability, valid MSAC flag/value, all source manual setup and visual evidence, 15-minute uncapped baseline, initial Present Power cap, every approved approximately-5-W step including final MSAC, a complete 20-minute graph window per step, Average-below-Cap acceptance with approved tolerance, allowed Maximum-excursion reporting, watchdog health and verified restoration. One cap, read-only telemetry, a shortened graph/smoke window, invalid/null MSAC, below-MSAC write, guessed HPE property on another vendor, or failed restoration cannot pass. Missing runtime mappings/thresholds is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Human-only OS target confirmation, secure license entry, physical AC handling and required WebUI operation; the agent must not install, unplug, enter secrets or claim visual observation.

Before AC handling, prove safe shutdown, exact all-feed topology and isolation; after restoration require BMC/POST/OS Ready before any cap/stress phase. Do not substitute BMC/DC cycle for the physical 30-second AC step.
Require valid firmware-reported MSAC and validity=true before constructing the decrement schedule; never calculate, guess or write below MSAC.
Preserve logs and original cap state. Use protected credentials, exact target, typed watts and write/readback; deny guessed URIs and license/key capture.
Arm independent thermal, input power, CPU/package performance, OS/service, BMC reachability and facility watchdogs before stress. No approved thresholds means NOT READY.

Each decrement is a scheduled new step, not a retry. Stop on first write/readback, monitoring, Average/Cap, performance, thermal, OS/BMC or alarm failure and do not continue lower or repeat automatically.
Restore original cap state on every safe exit; failed restore invokes the staffed incident runbook.
expected_evidence: HPE/iLO/firmware/license applicability, discovered MSAC/value-validity and cap-domain mapping, staged approvals and original state
Approved OS target/install proof plus human all-feed AC removal/restoration timestamps, 30-second dwell and POST/OS Ready recovery
Actual rendered iLO captures of initial/repeated Measured Power Values, Present Power, cap readbacks and complete 20-minute graphs
Uncapped 15-minute baseline and per-step cap/delta/readback, Average/Maximum/Cap, performance, thermal, power, OS/BMC and alarm time series through final MSAC
Stop/no-retry audit, allowed excursions, restored cap/workload/system state, final health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any anomaly, stop stress and scheduled decrements without retry, preserve all logs and keep the system in the owner-defined safe state. When safe and separately authorized, restore the captured original cap enable/value/mode; verify readback, thermal/power/performance/OS/BMC/service health and no residual workload. For failed restoration or instability, use the staffed HPE power/OS incident runbook and do not improvise another cap or power cycle.

source_conflict.reason: HPE authority defines MSAC and validity, resolving the missing terminal value. iLO wording is an explicit applicability gate rather than a generic-vendor command, and 60-minute Machine Time is planning metadata; all source phases remain preserved.

blocked.reason: The HPE-defined safe floor and validity flag make the sweep bounded. Exact platform, OS/feed/license, stress, thresholds and restore values are finite Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact HPE/iLO/firmware and valid MSAC resource; OS/storage target; all-feed AC map; secure license; stress profile; per-step 20-minute sampling/tolerance; watchdog thresholds; original/final cap and incident recovery.

external_authorities.title: HPE iLO 7 Redfish other resource definitions
external_authorities.application: Defines `Oem.Hpe.MinimumSafelyAchievableCap` as the lowest safe group-manager cap and the separate validity flag; also exposes cap-impact metrics on applicable iLO 7 firmware.

external_authorities.title: HPE iLO 6 Redfish other resource definitions
external_authorities.application: Defines the same MSAC/validity semantics and PowerMetrics Average/Max/Min plus IntervalInMin for supported iLO 6 resources.

external_authorities.title: HPE iLO 4 Redfish API reference
external_authorities.application: Defines LimitInWatts, correction/exception behavior, AverageConsumedWatts/IntervalInMin and HPE warnings for unsupported, unavailable or overly low cap values; exact generation support must be checked.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Property Guide 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Provides standard PowerLimit property semantics while leaving HPE OEM MSAC and platform applicability to HPE documentation.

project_authority: The Project owner selects an applicable HPE/iLO firmware, approves OS/storage and physical AC preparation, license entitlement, stress profile, approximately-5-W schedule, tolerances/watchdogs and restoration. HPE supplies the authoritative MSAC floor; another vendor cannot reuse this case without its own approved equivalent and coverage disclosure.
